items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: getting out of Sylvester Lewis' band for not keeping time

ctx.x: That's right. So that was my experience of getting fired out of Wilbur Sweatman's band, messing up Charlie Skeet's audition, and getting out of Sylvester Lewis' band for not keeping time, and from then on is when I really started putting my thinking cap on and started working hard, trying to develop something. But that kind of experience, I mean it does you all the good in the world.

I mean it did me good, it made me realize that you know, the more you study, the more you find out you don't know and you've got to keep on studying, you know, and just don't get brought down because you got fired, I guess a lot of guys got fired off the first gigs that they ever went on, you know.
